eyebrow.zh: 国产模型 · per-span 兜底门
eyebrow.en: 国产模型 · per-span fallback gate

headline.zh: 没把握的一步，别再让模型硬编下去
headline.en: Stop letting your model barrel through the step it isn't sure of

sub.zh: 把模型自报的不确定度和一次机器可校验的探针配对，只有两者同时亮红灯才把这一步交给人确认——探针真会触发、不确定度取自模型真实评分，不是占位。
sub.en: Pair the model's self-reported uncertainty with a machine-checkable probe; route the step to a human only when both go red — the probes actually fire and the uncertainty comes from the model's real scores, not a placeholder.

scroll.en: See what it catches for you

title.zh: 只拦真正没把握的那一步
title.en: Halt only the step that's genuinely uncertain

body.zh: 单信号都不够：模型嘴上说没把握，或探针单独失败，都只是标记、不拦。只有「模型自报不确定 ∧ 探针真失败」同时出现，才把这一步交给人——其余全部放行。
body.en: Either signal alone is not enough: the model saying it's unsure, or a probe failing on its own, just flags the step. Only when self-reported uncertainty AND a failed probe fire together does the step go to a human — everything else proceeds.

chips: › 不确定度 + 探针 同时亮

title.zh: 它说会查的，就真的会查
title.en: What it says it checks, it really checks

body.zh: 一道兜底门最怕的不是漏报，是「号称会查、却静默放行」——那比不装还危险，给你假的安全感。现在每一项它承诺的检查都真触发：散落的 print 会被抓出来；schema 里说不认识的类型会直接报错，而不是装作「都验过了」；缺了该交的数据块会明明白白失败，而不是假通过。
body.en: A guardrail's worst failure isn't a miss — it's claiming to check something and then silently letting it through, which is worse than no guardrail because it hands you false confidence. Now every check it promises actually fires: a stray print gets flagged; an unknown schema type is surfaced instead of a fake 'all typed'; a missing payload fails honestly instead of fake-passing.

chips: › 未知类型不再装作验过

title.zh: 不确定度是模型真实评分，不是占位
title.en: The uncertainty is the model's real score, not a placeholder

body.zh: 一道建在假数字上的门只是表演。所以不确定度直接取自模型自己每个 token 的评分——校准最弱的国产模型 serving tier，正是这个信号最该有人兜着的地方；它从不单方定生死，只和探针做 AND 才出手。
body.en: A gate built on a made-up number is theater. So the uncertainty is read straight from the model's own per-token scores — the 国产模型 serving tier, where calibration is weakest, is exactly where this signal most needs a human backing it up; it never decides on its own, only AND-ed with a probe.

chips: › 取自模型逐 token 评分

title.zh: 测试钉着，不会偷偷退回去
title.en: Tests pin it so it can't quietly slip back

body.zh: 「静默放行」那一类 bug 之所以可怕，是它不报错、看着像没事。所以每一项它承诺的检查都配一条回归测试，用一个该触发的事实去断言它真触发——这一类「装作没事」的 bug 回不来，门就一直是真门。
body.en: The 'silently passed' class of bug is scary because it throws no error and looks fine. So every check the probe promises ships with a regression test that asserts it fires on a case it should catch — that 'pretend-it's-fine' class can't quietly come back, and the gate stays a real gate.

chips: › 每道检查都有测试盯着
› 装作没事的 bug 回不来

sub.zh: 一条命令装上，demo 里第 4 步就会弹门。
sub.en: Install in one command — the demo trips the gate at step 4.
